source_title: Title 408 NAC Chapter 3 — NDOT Oversize/Overweight Permit Regulations (rev. 2023-04-30)
verify_reasons: The official NDOT documents were read via a server-side fetch proxy of the official dot.nebraska.gov URLs (the state host refused direct connections this run); content is verbatim from Title 408 NAC Ch. 3 and the NDOT Chapter 3 manual, but was not fetched from the NDOT host directly.
Standalone semitrailer length is not stated as a discrete number in the official NDOT docs (they codify 40' single / 65' combination); the 53' national-network default is used for the length field.

superload_thresholds.note: Superload (Title 408 NAC Ch. 3, 001.29) = over 16' wide, over 15'11" high, over 150' long, and/or over 160,000 lbs gross. Superload single-trip permits are reviewed by the Lincoln Permit Office (up to 5 working days), with possible Bridge Division / District Engineer review. Height over 16' also requires a route survey.

width.note: 1 escort over 12' to 16' wide (Title 408 NAC Ch. 3, 003.19); front on 2-lane/undivided, rear (<=300 ft) on divided

height.note: pole (height) car required over 14'6" high (003.21A); over 16' also requires a route survey

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip: overdimensional-only $15; overweight-only $20; both oversize and overweight $25 (Title 408 NAC Ch. 3, 009.04).
single_trip.note: Flat single-trip fees by permit type; no per-mile component.

annual.note: Continuous/annual permit $25 per quarter (or part), capped at $100 for a one-year period (Title 408 NAC Ch. 3, 009.05).

movement_restrictions: Overdimensional loads move only 30 minutes before sunrise to 30 minutes after sunset (Title 408 NAC Ch. 3, 003.14)
Overweight-only permits may move 24 hours a day, 7 days a week (003.15)
Peak-hour curfew in the Lincoln and Omaha areas: no overdimensional movement 7:00-9:00 AM and 4:00-6:00 PM on weekdays (003.13)
No overdimensional movement on holidays unless specifically authorized; no movement in poor visibility, precipitation or slippery conditions
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 14'6" (confirmed — higher than the common 13'6"/14'0"), single-vehicle length 40', combination 65', gross 80,000 lbs (axle/bridge-formula governed, Neb. Rev. Stat. 60-6,294).
Where the NDOT Chapter 3 manual and Title 408 NAC Ch. 3 differ (e.g. escort length bands), the binding Admin Code (NAC) numbers are used here.
Escort, superload, fee and legal limits confirmed from the official Title 408 NAC Ch. 3 and NDOT Chapter 3 permit manual.
